principles: real secrets are runtime-only and never tracked
one immutable application image serves web, Horizon and scheduler roles
external PostgreSQL is recommended for production growth and failure isolation

commands.configure: create or update runtime-only production environment configuration
commands.doctor: validate Docker, environment, Compose and service connectivity
commands.build: build immutable application and edge images
commands.down: stop application processes without deleting durable volumes
commands.status: show process and application runtime status

single-host.purpose: small production, staging or simple VPS deployment

production.purpose: durable data isolation and independent service scaling

custom.purpose: operator-selected topology without changing SongChart internal service identities
